title.zh: Visa combines VisaNet data with onchain lending to power stablecoin card working capital
title.en: Visa combines VisaNet data with onchain lending to power stablecoin card working capital

current_state.zh: Visa正在将VisaNet结算数据与基于区块链的借贷相结合，帮助与稳定币关联的卡项目和金融科技公司获取营运资金；该模式自2023年以来已融资超过25亿美元的结算量，Visa的稳定币结算量年化率已超过200亿美元。
current_state.en: Visa is combining VisaNet settlement data with blockchain-based lending to help stablecoin-linked card programs and fintechs access working capital; the model has financed over $2.5 billion in settlement volume since 2023, and Visa's stablecoin settlement volume has risen to an annualized rate above $20 billion.

updates.title_zh: Visa Taps Onchain Lending to Finance Stablecoin Card Programs
updates.title_en: Visa Taps Onchain Lending to Finance Stablecoin Card Programs
updates.what_changed_zh: Visa宣布其稳定币结算量年化率已超过200亿美元，与Credit Coop的早期融资模式自2023年以来支持了超过25亿美元的累计结算量，且零违约。
updates.what_changed_en: Visa announced that its stablecoin settlement volume has exceeded a $20 billion annualized rate, and an early financing model with Credit Coop has supported more than $2.5 billion in cumulative settlement volume since 2023 with zero defaults.
updates.current_state_zh: Visa正在将VisaNet结算数据与基于区块链的借贷相结合，帮助与稳定币关联的卡项目和金融科技公司获取营运资金；该模式自2023年以来已融资超过25亿美元的结算量，Visa的稳定币结算量年化率已超过200亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: Visa is combining VisaNet settlement data with blockchain-based lending to help stablecoin-linked card programs and fintechs access working capital; the model has financed over $2.5 billion in settlement volume since 2023, and Visa's stablecoin settlement volume has risen to an annualized rate above $20 billion.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Visa is using VisaNet settlement data and blockchain records to help lenders finance stablecoin-linked card programs, with over $2.5 billion in settlement volume supported since 2023.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Visa is using VisaNet settlement data and blockchain records to help lenders finance stablecoin-linked card programs, with over $2.5 billion in settlement volume supported since 2023.
